Beyond the course list

  • Overall GPA At least a 2.0 overall GPA for an undergraduate degree.
  • Liberal arts and sciences credits Bachelor of Science degrees need at least 60 credits in the liberal arts and sciences; general education and arts and sciences electives count toward it.

Excelsior’s transfer rules

  • Up to 113 semester credits from other sources can count toward the 120-credit degree.
  • At least 7 semester credits must be completed at Excelsior.
  • At least 30 semester credits must be upper-level.

Pace used in this example

  • 2–4 completed outside courses per month is a planning assumption, not a provider promise.
  • 6–12 credits per university trimester is a planning assumption.
  • Outside providers are studied one after another in this scenario; overlapping study can change the elapsed time.
  • University loads use unit totals. Prerequisites, whole-course scheduling, start dates, breaks and registration availability can add time.
  • One-time university fees are included once; subtract charges you have already paid.

What this range leaves out

  • StraighterLine membership and individual course charges are not included. Pay-as-you-go uses a monthly membership plus course fees; prepaid plans cover only listed eligible courses, and lab kits may cost extra.
  • Uses standard per-credit tuition. Partner tuition (which requires partner eligibility and brings the 15-Excelsior-credit partnership rule) and the BS in Business fixed-rate trimester option are not used.
  • Excelsior does not publish a standard credit load per trimester in the reviewed sources; the trimester count uses a planning-assumption pace.
  • The optional $300 post-admission credit evaluation, the 2.85% card service fee and graduation regalia are not included.
  • Applicable sales tax on course subscriptions.
  • Books, supplies, course-specific charges and transcript charges when applicable.
  • Housing, meals, travel, health insurance and other living costs.
  • Rates are before financial aid, military benefits, scholarships, discounts and future price changes.
  • Completed or reported courses are excluded from new course charges; school acceptance of reported credit remains separate.
  • This is a range of known tuition, required university fees and selected outside-course charges, not a complete cost of attendance or a graduation-date promise.
  • Study.com uses the full College Saver Pro library price; an eligible lower-priced membership may reduce your cost.
  • Sophia uses the lowest published mix of monthly, four-month and annual memberships for the assumed study time. Prepaid plans require the upfront payment; promotions and tax are excluded.

Questions

Does Sophia English Composition I transfer to Excelsior University?

Excelsior’s published transfer guidance lists Sophia English Composition I for ENG 101A Advanced Composition (3 semester credits) in the Bachelor of Science in Psychology, with conditions. Ask Excelsior to confirm it for your transcript before you pay for the course.

Does Sophia English Composition II transfer to Excelsior University?

Excelsior’s published transfer guidance lists Sophia English Composition II for ENG 102A Advanced Composition II (3 semester credits) in the Bachelor of Science in Psychology, with conditions. Ask Excelsior to confirm it for your transcript before you pay for the course.

Does StraighterLine Business Ethics transfer to Excelsior University?

Excelsior’s published transfer guidance lists StraighterLine Business Ethics for IND 203 Introduction to Professional Ethics (3 semester credits) in the Bachelor of Science in Psychology, with conditions. Ask Excelsior to confirm it for your transcript before you pay for the course.

How many credits can I transfer into Excelsior University’s Bachelor of Science in Psychology?

Excelsior’s published limit for this 120-credit degree is 113 semester credits from other sources. At least 7 semester credits must be completed at Excelsior. This plan proposes 78 semester credits through outside courses.

Which courses must I take at Excelsior University?

In this plan, 42 semester credits are taken at Excelsior, including INL 102 Information Literacy, IND 101 Cornerstone A: Foundations and LA 498PSY Psychology Capstone. Excelsior requires at least 7 semester credits at Excelsior.

How much does this plan cost?

The planning estimate is $25,133 to $25,670 before aid. It covers tuition, listed fees and the outside courses in this plan. It is not a complete cost of attendance.

Has Excelsior University confirmed this plan?

Not yet. Some course matches or open choices in this plan still need Excelsior’s confirmation. Questions to ask: Ask the school: what is the most ACE- or NCCRS-recommended credit you accept toward this degree? Ask the school: is there a time limit on how old transfer credit can be? Its published sources disagree. Admission and your transcript evaluation are always Excelsior’s decisions.
